name: promptly
description: Scores how effectively you prompt Claude, per project folder.
long_description: Prompt.ly reads the Claude Code session logs already on your machine, scores every prompt 0-10 across clarity, specificity, context, constraints, scope, examples and token efficiency, tracks what each turn actually cost in tokens, and reports how you're doing in whichever folder you have open in VS Code. Reports are cached, so re-opening a project is instant. Nothing leaves your machine.

tools.name: prompt_report
tools.description: Prompt-quality report for the project folder open in your editor.

tools.name: score_draft_prompt
tools.description: Score a draft prompt 0-10 with concrete suggestions before you send it.

tools.name: detect_workspace
tools.description: Show which folders are open in VS Code / Cursor.

tools.name: list_tracked_projects
tools.description: List every project Prompt.ly has recorded prompts for.

tools.name: refresh_data
tools.description: Re-read Claude Code logs and rebuild the report.

workspace_override.title: Default project folder
workspace_override.description: Optional. When set, reports always target this folder instead of auto-detecting the one open in VS Code.
